family.description: This entry, previously know as DUF4054, represents Pseudomonas bacteriophage E217 head-to-tail connector protein gp27 and related proteins, including bacteriophage T1 adaptor protein gp45 [[cite:PUB00153918],[cite:PUB00163740]]. Twelve copies of the head-to-tail adaptor gp27 assemble on the portal dodecamer [[cite:PUB00153918]]. Gp27 assembles to the portal by inserting its extended C-terminal tail at the interface generated by two portal subunits, suggesting the head-to-tail connector oligomerizes upon binding instead of existing as a pre-formed ring [[cite:PUB00153918]].
family.name: E217 head-to-tail connector protein gp27-like
